<![CDATA[import type { Metadata, Viewport } from "next";
import { EB_Garamond, Inter } from "next/font/google";
import "./strata/strata.css";

const ebGaramond = EB_Garamond({
  subsets: ["latin"],
  variable: "--font-garamond",
  display: "swap",
  style: ["normal", "italic"],
});

const inter = Inter({
  subsets: ["latin"],
  variable: "--font-inter",
  display: "swap",
});

export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title: "STRATA — Formed by Earth",
  description: "Contemporary ceramic vessels. A study of earth, form, and considered living with interactive material finishes.",
  openGraph: {
    title: "STRATA — Formed by Earth",
    description: "Contemporary ceramic vessels. A study of earth, form, and considered living with interactive material finishes.",
    type: "website",
  },
  twitter: {
    card: "summary_large_image",
  },
};

export const viewport: Viewport = {
  width: "device-width",
  initialScale: 1,
  themeColor: "#25221e",
};

export default function StrataLayout({
  children,
}: {
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <html lang="en" className={`${ebGaramond.variable} ${inter.variable} scroll-smooth`}>
      <body className="bg-[#25221e] text-[#f4ecdf] antialiased">
        {children}
      </body>
    </html>
  );
}
]]>

<![CDATA[/* STRATA typography bindings */
:root {
  --display: var(--font-garamond), 'Bodoni MT', 'Didot', 'EB Garamond', Georgia, serif;
  --sans: var(--font-inter), 'Inter', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;
}

:root{--ink:#292620;--bone:#e9e1d6;--paper:#efe9df;--stone:#bda78f;--clay:#af765d;--line:rgba(45,40,34,.2);--dark:#24221f;--display:'Bodoni MT','Didot','EB Garamond','Iowan Old Style','Times New Roman',Georgia,serif;--sans:'Inter','Inter Display','Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;--ease:cubic-bezier(.18,.74,.2,1);--vh:100vh}
*,*:before,*:after{box-sizing:border-box}html{scroll-behavior:smooth;scroll-padding-top:82px}body{margin:0;background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--sans);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;overflow-x:hidden}button,input,select,textarea{font:inherit}button{cursor:pointer}a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}img{display:block;max-width:100%}::selection{background:#b89c81;color:#1f1d19}button:focus-visible,a:focus-visible,input:focus-visible,textarea:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #c58e6a;outline-offset:4px}body.is-locked{overflow:hidden}
.skip-link{position:fixed;top:-60px;left:16px;z-index:1100;background:white;color:black;padding:12px 18px}.skip-link:focus{top:12px}
/* architectural grain, softly integrated */
.grain{pointer-events:none;position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:150;opacity:.2;mix-blend-mode:soft-light;background-image:url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox='0 0 140 140' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cfilter id='n'%3E%3CfeTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='.72' numOctaves='3' stitchTiles='stitch'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width='100%25' height='100%25' filter='url(%23n)' opacity='.4'/%3E%3C/svg%3E")}
/* reveal and shared typography */
.eyebrow,.tiny,.chapter-label,.meta{font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.17em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:10px;line-height:1.45}.tiny{font-size:9px}.serif{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:400}.italic{font-style:italic}.eyebrow .dash{display:inline-block;height:1px;width:25px;background:currentColor;vertical-align:middle;margin:0 12px 3px}.body-copy{font-size:clamp(14px,1.12vw,17px);line-height:1.75;font-weight:300;letter-spacing:.005em}.reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(34px);transition:transform .95s var(--ease),opacity .95s var(--ease)}.reveal.in-view{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}.reveal.d1{transition-delay:.13s}.reveal.d2{transition-delay:.28s}
/* nav chrome */
.nav{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:200;color:#f2e8dc;transition:color .5s;--nav-border:rgba(255,255,255,.24);--nav-fill:rgba(245,241,235,.12);--nav-glass:rgba(35,33,30,.11)}body.light-nav .nav{color:#292620;--nav-border:rgba(41,38,32,.24);--nav-fill:rgba(42,39,34,.08);--nav-glass:rgba(249,246,239,.48)}.nav-inner{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr;align-items:center;height:89px;margin:0 4.5%;border-bottom:1px solid var(--nav-border);transition:border-color .5s}.wordmark{font-family:var(--display);font-size:34px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:-.055em;line-height:1;display:inline-flex;align-items:baseline}.wordmark i{font-family:var(--sans);font-style:normal;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.04em;margin-left:5px}.nav-center{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:34px}.nav-center a,.nav-cta,.nav-menu{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.13em;text-transform:uppercase;white-space:nowrap}.nav-center a{position:relative;padding:16px 0;opacity:.82;transition:opacity .25s}.nav-center a:after{content:'';position:absolute;left:0;bottom:8px;height:1px;width:100%;background:currentColor;transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:left;transition:transform .35s}.nav-center a:hover{opacity:1}.nav-center a:hover:after{transform:scaleX(1)}.nav-right{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;gap:18px;align-items:center}.nav-cta{display:inline-flex;gap:18px;align-items:center;padding:12px 17px;border:1px solid var(--nav-border);border-radius:100px;background:var(--nav-fill);transition:background .25s,transform .25s}.nav-cta:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);background:rgba(196,167,141,.22)}.nav-cta svg{width:16px;height:16px}.menu-button{display:none;background:none;border:none;color:inherit;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase}.menu-button .menu-ic{width:21px;height:12px;position:relative;display:inline-block;margin-left:10px}.menu-button .menu-ic:before,.menu-button .menu-ic:after{content:'';height:1px;background:currentColor;position:absolute;right:0;transition:width .3s,transform .3s}.menu-button .menu-ic:before{width:100%;top:1px}.menu-button .menu-ic:after{width:65%;bottom:1px}.menu-button:hover .menu-ic:after{width:100%}
/* progress indicator */
.scroll-rail{position:fixed;right:25px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);height:132px;width:1px;background:rgba(150,138,125,.37);z-index:170;pointer-events:none}.scroll-rail .scroll-fill{position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:1px;height:var(--scrollprogress,0%);background:#ab7e5f}.scroll-rail .scroll-dot{position:absolute;top:var(--scrollprogress,0%);left:-3px;width:7px;height:7px;background:#caa17e;border-radius:50%}.rail-label{position:absolute;top:-42px;right:-2px;color:#a68f7c;white-space:nowrap;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.08em;writing-mode:vertical-rl;transform:translateY(-100%) rotate(180deg)}
/* page opening */
.loader{position:fixed;inset:0;background:#211e1b;color:#e9ded1;z-index:999;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-direction:column;transition:clip-path 1.15s cubic-bezier(.74,0,.17,1),visibility 1.15s;clip-path:inset(0 0 0 0)}.loader.is-done{clip-path:inset(0 0 100% 0);visibility:hidden}.loader-name{font-family:var(--display);letter-spacing:-.04em;font-size:clamp(60px,10vw,150px);line-height:.9}.loader-rule{width:min(280px,52vw);height:1px;background:#554d43;margin-top:25px;overflow:hidden}.loader-rule span{display:block;height:100%;background:#ddd0bc;transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:left;animation:loadline 1.1s ease forwards}.loader-caption{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.22em;margin-top:15px;color:#8f8274}@keyframes loadline{to{transform:scaleX(1)}}
/* HERO - Centered Gallery Composition */
.hero{height:182svh;background:#25221e;color:#f4ecdf;position:relative;--p:0}
.hero-sticky,.sticky{height:100svh;min-height:560px;position:sticky;top:0;overflow:hidden;isolation:isolate}
.hero-sticky{background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 50%,#46392d 0%,#292520 48%,#1c1b19 88%)}
.hero-sticky:before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:-30%;background:conic-gradient(from 9deg at 50% 50%,transparent 0deg,rgba(190,161,119,.055) 55deg,transparent 130deg,rgba(255,221,181,.07) 240deg,transparent 310deg);transform:rotate(calc(var(--p) * 35deg));pointer-events:none}
.hero-sticky:after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(to bottom,rgba(15,14,12,.15),transparent 25%,transparent 65%,rgba(15,14,12,.28));pointer-events:none;z-index:5}

/* Atmospheric concentric rings & spotlight behind vessel */
.hero-circles{position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;width:min(72vw,880px);aspect-ratio:1;border:1px solid rgba(223,209,190,.12);border-radius:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(calc(1 + var(--p)*.42));z-index:1;pointer-events:none;opacity:0;transition:opacity 1.2s ease}
.hero-circles:before,.hero-circles:after{content:'';position:absolute;border:1px solid rgba(223,209,190,.09);border-radius:50%;inset:13%}
.hero-circles:after{inset:28%}
.hero-spotlight{position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;width:min(54vw,680px);aspect-ratio:1;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(215,178,140,.18) 0%,rgba(70,57,45,.08) 46%,transparent 72%);pointer-events:none;border-radius:50%;opacity:0;transition:opacity 1.4s ease;z-index:1}
.hero-vertical-line{position:absolute;width:1px;top:0;bottom:0;left:50%;background:linear-gradient(transparent,rgba(231,221,207,.08) 45%,transparent);pointer-events:none;z-index:1}

/* Stage Flex Layout (guarantees headline, vessel, and subtitle never collide) */
.hero-stage-content{position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:max(88px,10svh) 4% max(26px,4svh);z-index:4;pointer-events:none}

/* Top Group: Collection Identifier & Main Headline */
.hero-top-group{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;text-align:center;width:100%;max-width:1380px;margin:0 auto;pointer-events:auto;transform:translate3d(0,calc(var(--p)* -26vh),0);opacity:clamp(0,calc(1 - var(--p)*2.2),1);will-change:transform,opacity}
.hero-collection-wrap{overflow:hidden;margin-bottom:clamp(7px,1.2vh,14px);display:inline-block}
.hero-collection-label{display:block;font-family:var(--sans);font-size:clamp(9px,0.72vw,11px);font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.28em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#bda996;line-height:1.4;transform:translateY(115%);opacity:0;transition:transform .9s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),opacity .7s ease}
.hero-title-wrap{overflow:hidden;display:inline-block}
.hero-headline{display:block;font-family:var(--display);font-size:clamp(3rem,6.8vw,7.2rem);font-weight:400;letter-spacing:-.038em;line-height:.92;margin:0;text-transform:uppercase;color:#f4ecdf;text-align:center;transform:translateY(108%) rotate(1.2deg);transform-origin:left bottom;opacity:0;transition:transform 1.15s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),opacity .8s ease}

/* Center Vessel Anchor */
.hero-vessel-stage{position:relative;width:100%;flex:1 1 auto;min-height:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;pointer-events:none;padding:4px 0}
.hero-object-holder{position:relative;width:min(52vw,580px);height:clamp(300px,58svh,620px);max-height:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;z-index:3;transform:translate3d(calc(var(--mx,0)*12px),calc(var(--my,0)*-8px + var(--p)*8vh),0) scale(calc(1 + var(--p)*.48));transform-origin:center center;will-change:transform;pointer-events:none}
.hero-object-anim{width:100%;height:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;transform:translateY(32px) scale(.94);opacity:0;transition:transform 1.25s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),opacity .9s ease}
.hero-object-holder img{height:100%;width:100%;object-fit:contain;filter:drop-shadow(24px 38px 32px rgba(10,9,9,.42))}
.hero-ground{position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:4%;width:min(34vw,440px);height:30px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(15,11,8,.36);filter:blur(22px);transform:translateX(-50%) scale(calc(1 + var(--p)*.4));z-index:2;pointer-events:none;opacity:0;transition:opacity 1.2s ease}

/* Bottom Group: Italic Statement */
.hero-bottom-group{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;text-align:center;width:100%;pointer-events:auto;transform:translate3d(0,calc(var(--p)* 18vh),0);opacity:clamp(0,calc(1 - var(--p)*2.2),1);will-change:transform,opacity;margin-bottom:clamp(4px,1vh,12px)}
.hero-subtitle-wrap{overflow:hidden;display:inline-block}
.hero-subtitle{display:block;font-family:var(--display);font-style:italic;font-weight:400;font-size:clamp(1.6rem,3vw,3rem);letter-spacing:-.025em;color:#e5d7c7;margin:0;text-align:center;transform:translateY(110%) rotate(-1deg);transform-origin:center bottom;opacity:0;transition:transform 1.05s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),opacity .8s ease}

/* Corner Metadata & Interface Accents */
.hero-text-left{position:absolute;left:5.1%;bottom:5.5%;z-index:6;max-width:285px;transform:translate3d(0,calc(var(--p)*20px),0);opacity:clamp(0,calc(1 - var(--p)*2.2),1);will-change:transform,opacity}
.hero-text-left-inner{transform:translateY(16px);opacity:0;transition:opacity .85s ease,transform .85s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}
.hero-text-left p{font-size:13px;line-height:1.65;color:#c1b7aa;margin:8px 0 0}
.hero-text-right{position:absolute;right:5.1%;bottom:5.5%;z-index:6;transform:translate3d(0,calc(var(--p)*20px),0);opacity:clamp(0,calc(1 - var(--p)*2.2),1);will-change:transform,opacity}
.hero-text-right-inner{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;transform:translateY(16px);opacity:0;transition:opacity .85s ease,transform .85s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}
.hero-scroll-ring{width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid rgba(225,209,187,.55);display:grid;place-items:center;animation:ringbreathe 4s ease-in-out infinite}
.hero-scroll-ring svg{width:18px;height:18px}
.hero-side-note{position:absolute;left:4.8%;top:49%;writing-mode:vertical-rl;transform:rotate(180deg) translateY(-14px);color:#a99d8d;z-index:3;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.21em;opacity:0;transition:opacity .85s ease,transform .85s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}
.hero-index{position:absolute;right:5%;top:42%;font-family:var(--display);font-size:clamp(45px,6vw,102px);color:rgba(244,236,223,.14);font-weight:400;z-index:2;opacity:0;transform:translateY(14px);transition:opacity .85s ease,transform .85s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}
.hero-hairline{position:absolute;bottom:3.5%;left:5%;width:90%;height:1px;background:rgba(227,216,198,.18);z-index:6;opacity:0;transition:opacity .85s ease}

/* Entrance Animation Active State (.hero-entered) */
body.hero-entered .hero-collection-label{transform:translateY(0);opacity:1;transition-delay:.10s}
body.hero-entered .hero-headline{transform:translateY(0) rotate(0deg);opacity:1;transition-delay:.26s}
body.hero-entered .hero-object-anim{transform:translateY(0) scale(1);opacity:1;transition-delay:.44s}
body.hero-entered .hero-spotlight{opacity:1;transition-delay:.44s}
body.hero-entered .hero-ground{opacity:1;transition-delay:.44s}
body.hero-entered .hero-circles{opacity:1;transition-delay:.58s}
body.hero-entered .hero-subtitle{transform:translateY(0) rotate(0deg);opacity:1;transition-delay:.68s}
body.hero-entered .hero-side-note{opacity:clamp(0,calc(1 - var(--p)*2.5),1);transform:rotate(180deg) translateY(0);transition-delay:.88s}
body.hero-entered .hero-index{opacity:clamp(0,calc(1 - var(--p)*2.5),1);transform:translateY(0);transition-delay:.88s}
body.hero-entered .hero-text-left-inner{transform:translateY(0);opacity:1;transition-delay:.88s}
body.hero-entered .hero-text-right-inner{transform:translateY(0);opacity:1;transition-delay:.88s}
body.hero-entered .hero-hairline{opacity:clamp(0,calc(1 - var(--p)*2.2),1);transition-delay:.88s}
@keyframes ringbreathe{50%{transform:translateY(5px)}}
/* INBETWEEN / editorial pause */
.manifesto{background:#e8dfd1;color:#302b25;min-height:85vh;display:flex;align-items:center;padding:135px 8% 120px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}.manifesto:before{content:'S';position:absolute;right:-3%;top:-37%;font-family:var(--display);font-size:65vw;color:rgba(102,81,64,.035);line-height:1}.manifesto-content{width:min(1100px,100%);margin:auto;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 2.7fr;gap:6vw;align-items:start}.manifesto .section-id{padding-top:19px;color:#8b7764}.manifesto-statement{font-family:var(--display);font-size:clamp(49px,7.1vw,113px);letter-spacing:-.058em;line-height:.97;font-weight:400;margin:0}.manifesto-statement em{font-weight:400;color:#af8165}.manifesto-foot{max-width:350px;margin:32px 0 0 auto;font-size:15px;line-height:1.7;color:#71665b}.section-rule{height:1px;background:rgba(65,54,46,.23);margin-top:28px}
/* MACRO / IMMERSION */
.macro{height:290svh;--p:0;background:#24211e;color:#f3e9d8}.macro-stage{background:#28231e}.macro-vessel{position:absolute;left:50%;top:51%;height:73%;max-width:75%;object-fit:contain;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(calc(1 + var(--p)*2.6));opacity:clamp(0,calc(1 - var(--p)*3.3),1);z-index:1;filter:drop-shadow(15px 28px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.34))}.macro-picture{position:absolute;inset:-5%;width:110%;height:110%;object-fit:cover;clip-path:circle(calc(1% + var(--p)*114%) at 50% 55%);transform:scale(calc(1.18 - var(--p)*.16)) translateX(calc(var(--p)*-2%));filter:contrast(1.04) saturate(.77)}.macro-shade{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:2;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(20,17,14,.78),rgba(27,24,20,.13) 64%,rgba(18,17,16,.12));opacity:clamp(0,calc((var(--p) - .32)*2.6),1)}.macro-copy{position:absolute;z-index:3;left:7%;top:42%;transform:translateY(calc((1 - var(--p))*50px));opacity:clamp(0,calc((var(--p) - .36)*3.4),1)}.macro-copy h2{font-family:var(--display);font-size:clamp(73px,10vw,160px);line-height:.83;letter-spacing:-.058em;font-weight:400;margin:24px 0}.macro-copy h2 em{font-size:1.04em}.macro-side{position:absolute;z-index:3;right:6%;bottom:11%;max-width:240px;color:#e9d6c3;transform:translateY(calc((1 - var(--p))*45px));opacity:clamp(0,calc((var(--p) - .52)*4),1)}.macro-side p{font-size:14px;line-height:1.7}.macro-coord{position:absolute;z-index:3;right:5%;top:23%;writing-mode:vertical-rl;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.26em;color:#e5cbb4}
/* form index / object anatomy */
.object-study{background:#eee7dd;min-height:104vh;padding:150px 5.5% 130px;position:relative}.section-topline{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-top:17px;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#81756a}.study-layout{margin-top:58px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(250px,.8fr) minmax(500px,1.65fr);gap:5vw;align-items:center}.study-title{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:400;font-size:clamp(66px,8vw,130px);line-height:.84;letter-spacing:-.06em;margin:0}.study-title em{color:#ac846c;display:block}.study-copy{margin-top:32px;color:#74695e;max-width:315px;font-size:14px;line-height:1.8}.study-photo-wrap{background:#d9d5cd;position:relative;overflow:hidden;min-height:430px;display:flex;align-items:center}.study-photo-wrap img{width:100%;height:auto;transform:scale(1.055);transition:transform 1.6s var(--ease)}.study-photo-wrap:hover img{transform:scale(1)}.study-photo-label{position:absolute;left:22px;top:20px;color:#494641;background:rgba(240,233,223,.82);padding:8px 11px}.study-bottom{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:16px;margin-top:48px;padding-top:23px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}.study-spec{border-left:1px solid var(--line);padding-left:19px}.study-spec:first-child{border-left:0;padding-left:0}.study-spec strong{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:400;font-size:clamp(26px,3vw,46px);display:block;line-height:1.2}.study-spec span{font-size:10px;text-transform:uppercase;color:#8c7e70;letter-spacing:.12em}
/* CRAFT */
.craft{height:195svh;--p:0;background:#2e2721;color:#f5eadd}.craft-bg{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:55% 50%;transform:scale(calc(1.18 - var(--p)*.2)) translateX(calc(var(--p)*-1.6%));filter:saturate(.65) contrast(1.1)}.craft-vignette{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(22,18,16,.89) 0%,rgba(31,25,21,.54) 38%,rgba(17,14,12,.18) 70%),linear-gradient(to top,rgba(22,16,12,.7),transparent 35%)}.craft-copy{position:absolute;left:7%;top:26%;z-index:2;opacity:clamp(0,calc(var(--p)*3.6),1);transform:translateY(calc((1 - var(--p))*65px))}.craft-copy h2{font-family:var(--display);font-size:clamp(75px,11.4vw,177px);line-height:.77;letter-spacing:-.056em;font-weight:400;margin:28px 0}.craft-copy h2 em{color:#d0b49a}.craft-lede{font-size:15px;line-height:1.75;max-width:338px;color:#d8c9b8}.craft-step{position:absolute;right:6%;bottom:10%;border-top:1px solid rgba(234,217,201,.5);padding-top:17px;z-index:2;width:270px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:15px;opacity:clamp(0,calc((var(--p) - .44)*4),1)}.craft-step span{font-size:10px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.14em}.craft-step strong{font-family:var(--display);font-size:25px;font-weight:400}
/* interior reveal */

    <file path="src/app/(strata)/strata/StrataApp.tsx">
<![CDATA["use client";

import { useEffect, useState, useCallback, useRef } from "react";
import { Header } from "./components/Header";
import { HeroSection } from "./components/HeroSection";
import { ManifestoSection } from "./components/ManifestoSection";
import { MacroSection } from "./components/MacroSection";
import { ObjectStudySection } from "./components/ObjectStudySection";
import { CraftSection } from "./components/CraftSection";
import { InteriorSection } from "./components/InteriorSection";
import { CollectionSection, FINISHES } from "./components/CollectionSection";
import { EditionSection } from "./components/EditionSection";
import { ClosingSection } from "./components/ClosingSection";
import { Footer } from "./components/Footer";
import { InquiryModal } from "./components/InquiryModal";
import { CustomCursor } from "./components/CustomCursor";

const clamp = (n: number, a = 0, b = 1) => Math.min(b, Math.max(a, n));
const lerp = (a: number, b: number, t: number) => a + (b - a) * t;

export default function StrataApp() {
  const [heroProgress, setHeroProgress] = useState(0);
  const [macroProgress, setMacroProgress] = useState(0);
  const [craftProgress, setCraftProgress] = useState(0);
  const [interiorProgress, setInteriorProgress] = useState(0);
  const [collectionProgress, setCollectionProgress] = useState(0);
  const [activeFinish, setActiveFinish] = useState(0);
  const [isInquiryOpen, setIsInquiryOpen] = useState(false);
  const finishManuallyLockedRef = useRef(false);
  const finishLockTimerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);

  // Entrance animation trigger
  useEffect(() => {
    const reduced = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
    if (reduced) {
      document.body.classList.add("hero-entered");
    } else {
      const timer = setTimeout(() => {
        document.body.classList.add("hero-entered");
      }, 150);
      return () => clearTimeout(timer);
    }
  }, []);

  // Scroll handling and chapter progress calculation
  useEffect(() => {
    const reduced = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;

    const calcSceneProgress = (id: string) => {
      const el = document.getElementById(id);
      if (!el) return 0;
      const H = window.innerHeight;
      const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
      return clamp(-r.top / Math.max(1, r.height - H));
    };

    let rafId: number;
    let ticking = false;
    let currentHero = 0;
    let currentMacro = 0;
    let currentCraft = 0;
    let currentInterior = 0;
    let currentCollection = 0;

    const updateScroll = () => {
      const H = window.innerHeight;
      const targetHero = calcSceneProgress("top");
      const targetMacro = calcSceneProgress("material");
      const targetCraft = calcSceneProgress("craft");
      const targetInterior = calcSceneProgress("interior");
      const targetCollection = calcSceneProgress("collection");

      // Scroll progress bar
      const doc = Math.max(1, document.documentElement.scrollHeight - H);
      const portion = clamp(window.scrollY / doc);
      document.documentElement.style.setProperty("--scrollprogress", `${(portion * 100).toFixed(3)}%`);

      // Nav theme toggling
      const midpoint = H * 0.43;
      const sections = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll("[data-nav]")) as HTMLElement[];
      let currentSection: HTMLElement | null = null;
      for (const sec of sections) {
        const r = sec.getBoundingClientRect();
        if (r.top <= midpoint && r.bottom > midpoint) {
          currentSection = sec;
          break;
        }
      }
      document.body.classList.toggle("light-nav", currentSection?.dataset.nav === "light");

      // Smooth interpolation loop
      const step = () => {
        const factor = reduced ? 1 : 0.16;
        currentHero = reduced ? targetHero : lerp(currentHero, targetHero, factor);
        currentMacro = reduced ? targetMacro : lerp(currentMacro, targetMacro, factor);
        currentCraft = reduced ? targetCraft : lerp(currentCraft, targetCraft, factor);
        currentInterior = reduced ? targetInterior : lerp(currentInterior, targetInterior, factor);
        currentCollection = reduced ? targetCollection : lerp(currentCollection, targetCollection, factor);

        setHeroProgress(currentHero);
        setMacroProgress(currentMacro);
        setCraftProgress(currentCraft);
        setInteriorProgress(currentInterior);
        setCollectionProgress(currentCollection);

        // Auto finish switcher based on scroll position if not manually locked
        if (!finishManuallyLockedRef.current) {
          const collEl = document.getElementById("collection");
          if (collEl) {
            const r = collEl.getBoundingClientRect();
            if (r.top < H && r.bottom > 0) {
              const idx = currentCollection < 0.34 ? 0 : currentCollection < 0.69 ? 1 : 2;
              setActiveFinish(idx);
            }
          }
        }

        const isMoving =
          Math.abs(currentHero - targetHero) > 0.0005 ||
          Math.abs(currentMacro - targetMacro) > 0.0005 ||
          Math.abs(currentCraft - targetCraft) > 0.0005 ||
          Math.abs(currentInterior - targetInterior) > 0.0005 ||
          Math.abs(currentCollection - targetCollection) > 0.0005;

        if (isMoving && !reduced) {
          rafId = requestAnimationFrame(step);
        } else {
          ticking = false;
        }
      };

      if (!ticking) {
        ticking = true;
        rafId = requestAnimationFrame(step);
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener("scroll", updateScroll, { passive: true });
    window.addEventListener("resize", updateScroll, { passive: true });
    updateScroll();

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("scroll", updateScroll);
      window.removeEventListener("resize", updateScroll);
      cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);
    };
  }, []);

  const handleSelectFinish = useCallback((idx: number) => {
    setActiveFinish(idx);
    finishManuallyLockedRef.current = true;
    if (finishLockTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(finishLockTimerRef.current);
    finishLockTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
      finishManuallyLockedRef.current = false;
    }, 6000);
  }, []);

  const handleOpenInquiry = useCallback((finishName?: string) => {
    if (finishName) {
      const foundIdx = FINISHES.findIndex(
        (f) => f.name.toLowerCase() === finishName.toLowerCase()
      );
      if (foundIdx !== -1) setActiveFinish(foundIdx);
    }
    setIsInquiryOpen(true);
  }, []);

  const handleCloseInquiry = useCallback(() => {
    setIsInquiryOpen(false);
  }, []);

  return (
    <>
      <CustomCursor />
      <Header onOpenInquiry={handleOpenInquiry} />

      <main id="main">
        <HeroSection progress={heroProgress} />
        <ManifestoSection />
        <MacroSection progress={macroProgress} />
        <ObjectStudySection />
        <CraftSection progress={craftProgress} />
        <InteriorSection progress={interiorProgress} />
        <CollectionSection
          activeFinish={activeFinish}
          onSelectFinish={handleSelectFinish}
          progress={collectionProgress}
        />
        <EditionSection />
        <ClosingSection onOpenInquiry={() => handleOpenInquiry(FINISHES[activeFinish].name)} />
      </main>

      <Footer />

      <InquiryModal
        isOpen={isInquiryOpen}
        onClose={handleCloseInquiry}
        selectedFinish={FINISHES[activeFinish]?.name}
      />
    </>
  );
}
]]>

<![CDATA["use client";

import { useEffect, useRef } from "react";

export function CustomCursor() {
  const cursorRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!window.matchMedia("(pointer: fine)").matches) return;
    const reduced = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
    if (reduced) return;

    let targetX = 0;
    let targetY = 0;
    let cursorX = 0;
    let cursorY = 0;
    let active = false;
    let rafId: number;

    const handlePointerMove = (e: PointerEvent) => {
      targetX = e.clientX;
      targetY = e.clientY;
      if (!active) {
        cursorX = targetX;
        cursorY = targetY;
        active = true;
        if (cursorRef.current) cursorRef.current.classList.add("is-active");
      }
    };

    const handlePointerLeave = () => {
      active = false;
      if (cursorRef.current) cursorRef.current.classList.remove("is-active");
    };

    const loop = () => {
      if (active && cursorRef.current) {
        cursorX += (targetX - cursorX) * 0.22;
        cursorY += (targetY - cursorY) * 0.22;
        cursorRef.current.style.transform = `translate3d(${cursorX}px, ${cursorY}px, 0) translate(-50%, -50%)`;
      }
      rafId = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    };

    window.addEventListener("pointermove", handlePointerMove, { passive: true });
    document.addEventListener("mouseleave", handlePointerLeave);
    rafId = requestAnimationFrame(loop);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("pointermove", handlePointerMove);
      document.removeEventListener("mouseleave", handlePointerLeave);
      cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);
    };
  }, []);

  return <div ref={cursorRef} className="custom-cursor" id="custom-cursor" aria-hidden="true" />;
}
]]>

interface HeaderProps {

    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === "Escape" && isMenuOpen) {
        setIsMenuOpen(false);

    if (isMenuOpen) {
      document.body.classList.add("is-locked");
      window.addEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
    } else {
      document.body.classList.remove("is-locked");

    return () => {
      document.body.classList.remove("is-locked");
      window.removeEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);

export function HeroSection({ progress = 0 }: HeroSectionProps) {
  const heroRef = useRef<HTMLElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const heroStage = heroRef.current?.querySelector(".hero-sticky") as HTMLElement | null;
    if (!heroStage) return;

    const reduced = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;

    const handlePointerMove = (e: PointerEvent) => {
      if (!window.matchMedia("(pointer:fine)").matches || reduced) return;
      const r = heroStage.getBoundingClientRect();
      const x = ((e.clientX - r.left) / r.width - 0.5) * 2;
      const y = ((e.clientY - r.top) / r.height - 0.5) * 2;
      heroRef.current?.style.setProperty("--mx", x.toFixed(3));
      heroRef.current?.style.setProperty("--my", y.toFixed(3));
    };

    const handlePointerLeave = () => {
      heroRef.current?.style.setProperty("--mx", "0");
      heroRef.current?.style.setProperty("--my", "0");
    };

    heroStage.addEventListener("pointermove", handlePointerMove);
    heroStage.addEventListener("pointerleave", handlePointerLeave);

    return () => {
      heroStage.removeEventListener("pointermove", handlePointerMove);
      heroStage.removeEventListener("pointerleave", handlePointerLeave);
    };
  }, []);

  return (
    <section
      ref={heroRef}
      className="hero"

<![CDATA["use client";

import { useEffect, useState, useRef } from "react";

interface InquiryModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  selectedFinish?: string;
}

export function InquiryModal({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  selectedFinish = "Limestone",
}: InquiryModalProps) {
  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [finish, setFinish] = useState(selectedFinish);
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState("");
  const [submitted, setSubmitted] = useState(false);
  const dialogRef = useRef<HTMLDialogElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    setFinish(selectedFinish);
  }, [selectedFinish]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const dialog = dialogRef.current;
    if (!dialog) return;

    if (isOpen) {
      if (!dialog.open) dialog.showModal();
      document.body.classList.add("is-locked");
    } else {
      if (dialog.open) dialog.close();
      document.body.classList.remove("is-locked");
      setSubmitted(false);
    }

    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === "Escape" && isOpen) {
        onClose();
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
    return () => {
      document.body.classList.remove("is-locked");
      window.removeEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
    };
  }, [isOpen, onClose]);

  const handleSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!name || !email) return;
    setSubmitted(true);
  };

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  return (
    <dialog
      ref={dialogRef}
      className="dialog"
      id="inquire-dialog"
      aria-labelledby="dialog-title"
      onClick={(e) => {
        if (e.target === dialogRef.current) onClose();
      }}
    >
      <div className="dialog-inner">
        <button
          type="button"
          className="dialog-close"
          id="dialog-close"
          aria-label="Close dialog"
          onClick={onClose}
        >
          &times;
        </button>
        <span className="eyebrow">Studio acquisition</span>
        <h2 id="dialog-title">Vessel No. 01</h2>
        <p className="dialog-lede">
          Direct studio release. Numbered certificate, custom felt-lined timber crate, and insured global delivery.
        </p>

        {submitted ? (
          <div className="py-8 text-center" role="status">
            <h3 className="text-xl font-serif text-[#f4ecdf] mb-2">Inquiry Transmitted</h3>
            <p className="text-sm text-[#bda996]">
              Thank you, {name}. The Kyoto studio will be in touch within 24 business hours regarding availability of the {finish} edition.
            </p>
            <button
              type="button"
              className="submit-btn mt-6"
              onClick={onClose}
            >
              Return to studio
            </button>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <form id="inquiry-form" className="inquiry-form" onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
            <div className="form-row">
              <label htmlFor="client-name">Full name</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                id="client-name"
                required
                value={name}
                onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Architect, collector, or gallery"
              />
            </div>
            <div className="form-row">
              <label htmlFor="client-email">Email address</label>
              <input
                type="email"
                id="client-email"
                required
                value={email}
                onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="contact@studio.com"
              />
            </div>
            <div className="form-row">
              <label htmlFor="client-finish">Preferred finish</label>
              <select
                id="client-finish"
                value={finish}
                onChange={(e) => setFinish(e.target.value)}
              >
                <option value="Limestone">Limestone — Bone white chalky mineral</option>
                <option value="Volcanic">Volcanic — Charcoal graphite depth</option>
                <option value="Terracotta">Terracotta — Sun-fired raw earth</option>
              </select>
            </div>
            <div className="form-row">
              <label htmlFor="client-notes">Notes or shipping destination</label>
              <textarea
                id="client-notes"
                rows={3}
                value={notes}
                onChange={(e) => setNotes(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Country, space context, or delivery timeframe..."
              />
            </div>
            <div className="form-actions">
              <button type="submit" className="submit-btn">
                Transmit studio inquiry
              </button>
            </div>
          </form>
        )}
      </div>
    </dialog>
  );
}
]]>

          </p>

        <div className="study-layout">
          <div className="study-photo-wrap">
            <img
              src="/templates/strata/strata-03-vessel-reference.png"

            />

              <strong>380 × 240 mm</strong>
              <p>Height 38 cm, rim aperture 84 mm, base diameter 140 mm.</p>
            </div>
            <div className="study-spec">
              <span className="spec-label meta">WEIGHT &amp; DENSITY</span>
              <strong>4.2 kg</strong>
              <p>Thick-walled grogged stoneware providing stable ballast.</p>

              <span className="spec-label meta">FIRING SCHEDULE</span>
              <strong>1,280°C</strong>
              <p>Vitrified reduction firing over 36 hours in gas kiln.</p>

            <p>Strict numbered release of 48 specimens per finish.</p>
          </div>
          <div>
            <span className="meta">FUNCTIONALITY</span>
            <p>Water-tight interior glazing suitable for fresh stems or dry sculptural display.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

*,*:before,*:after{box-sizing:border-box}html{scroll-behavior:smooth;scroll-padding-top:82px}body{margin:0;background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--sans);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;overflow-x:hidden}button,input,select,textarea{font:inherit}button{cursor:pointer}a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}img{display:block;max-width:100%}::selection{background:#b89c81;color:#1f1d19}button:focus-visible,a:focus-visible,input:focus-visible,textarea:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #c58e6a;outline-offset:4px}body.is-locked{overflow:hidden}
.skip-link{position:fixed;top:-60px;left:16px;z-index:1100;background:white;color:black;padding:12px 18px}.skip-link:focus{top:12px}
/* architectural grain, softly integrated */
.grain{pointer-events:none;position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:150;opacity:.2;mix-blend-mode:soft-light;background-image:url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox='0 0 140 140' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cfilter id='n'%3E%3CfeTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='.72' numOctaves='3' stitchTiles='stitch'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width='100%25' height='100%25' filter='url(%23n)' opacity='.4'/%3E%3C/svg%3E")}
/* reveal and shared typography */
.eyebrow,.tiny,.chapter-label,.meta{font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.17em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:10px;line-height:1.45}.tiny{font-size:9px}.serif{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:400}.italic{font-style:italic}.eyebrow .dash{display:inline-block;height:1px;width:25px;background:currentColor;vertical-align:middle;margin:0 12px 3px}.body-copy{font-size:clamp(14px,1.12vw,17px);line-height:1.75;font-weight:300;letter-spacing:.005em}.reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(34px);transition:transform .95s var(--ease),opacity .95s var(--ease)}.reveal.in-view{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}.reveal.d1{transition-delay:.13s}.reveal.d2{transition-delay:.28s}
/* nav chrome */
.nav{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:200;color:#f2e8dc;transition:color .5s;--nav-border:rgba(255,255,255,.24);--nav-fill:rgba(245,241,235,.12);--nav-glass:rgba(35,33,30,.11)}body.light-nav .nav{color:#292620;--nav-border:rgba(41,38,32,.24);--nav-fill:rgba(42,39,34,.08);--nav-glass:rgba(249,246,239,.48)}.nav-inner{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr;align-items:center;height:89px;margin:0 4.5%;border-bottom:1px solid var(--nav-border);transition:border-color .5s}.wordmark{font-family:var(--display);font-size:34px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:-.055em;line-height:1;display:inline-flex;align-items:baseline}.wordmark i{font-family:var(--sans);font-style:normal;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.04em;margin-left:5px}.nav-center{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:34px}.nav-center a,.nav-cta,.nav-menu{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.13em;text-transform:uppercase;white-space:nowrap}.nav-center a{position:relative;padding:16px 0;opacity:.82;transition:opacity .25s}.nav-center a:after{content:'';position:absolute;left:0;bottom:8px;height:1px;width:100%;background:currentColor;transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:left;transition:transform .35s}.nav-center a:hover{opacity:1}.nav-center a:hover:after{transform:scaleX(1)}.nav-right{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;gap:18px;align-items:center}.nav-cta{display:inline-flex;gap:18px;align-items:center;padding:12px 17px;border:1px solid var(--nav-border);border-radius:100px;background:var(--nav-fill);transition:background .25s,transform .25s}.nav-cta:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);background:rgba(196,167,141,.22)}.nav-cta svg{width:16px;height:16px}.menu-button{display:none;background:none;border:none;color:inherit;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase}.menu-button .menu-ic{width:21px;height:12px;position:relative;display:inline-block;margin-left:10px}.menu-button .menu-ic:before,.menu-button .menu-ic:after{content:'';height:1px;background:currentColor;position:absolute;right:0;transition:width .3s,transform .3s}.menu-button .menu-ic:before{width:100%;top:1px}.menu-button .menu-ic:after{width:65%;bottom:1px}.menu-button:hover .menu-ic:after{width:100%}
/* progress indicator */
.scroll-rail{position:fixed;right:25px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);height:132px;width:1px;background:rgba(150,138,125,.37);z-index:170;pointer-events:none}.scroll-rail .scroll-fill{position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:1px;height:var(--scrollprogress,0%);background:#ab7e5f}.scroll-rail .scroll-dot{position:absolute;top:var(--scrollprogress,0%);left:-3px;width:7px;height:7px;background:#caa17e;border-radius:50%}.rail-label{position:absolute;top:-42px;right:-2px;color:#a68f7c;white-space:nowrap;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.08em;writing-mode:vertical-rl;transform:translateY(-100%) rotate(180deg)}
/* page opening */
.loader{position:fixed;inset:0;background:#211e1b;color:#e9ded1;z-index:999;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-direction:column;transition:clip-path 1.15s cubic-bezier(.74,0,.17,1),visibility 1.15s;clip-path:inset(0 0 0 0)}.loader.is-done{clip-path:inset(0 0 100% 0);visibility:hidden}.loader-name{font-family:var(--display);letter-spacing:-.04em;font-size:clamp(60px,10vw,150px);line-height:.9}.loader-rule{width:min(280px,52vw);height:1px;background:#554d43;margin-top:25px;overflow:hidden}.loader-rule span{display:block;height:100%;background:#ddd0bc;transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:left;animation:loadline 1.1s ease forwards}.loader-caption{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.22em;margin-top:15px;color:#8f8274}@keyframes loadline{to{transform:scaleX(1)}}
/* HERO - Centered Gallery Composition */
.hero{height:182svh;background:#25221e;color:#f4ecdf;position:relative;--p:0}
.hero-sticky,.sticky{height:100svh;min-height:560px;position:sticky;top:0;overflow:hidden;isolation:isolate}
.hero-sticky{background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 50%,#46392d 0%,#292520 48%,#1c1b19 88%)}
.hero-sticky:before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:-30%;background:conic-gradient(from 9deg at 50% 50%,transparent 0deg,rgba(190,161,119,.055) 55deg,transparent 130deg,rgba(255,221,181,.07) 240deg,transparent 310deg);transform:rotate(calc(var(--p) * 35deg));pointer-events:none}
.hero-sticky:after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(to bottom,rgba(15,14,12,.15),transparent 25%,transparent 65%,rgba(15,14,12,.28));pointer-events:none;z-index:5}

/* Atmospheric concentric rings & spotlight behind vessel */
.hero-circles{position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;width:min(72vw,880px);aspect-ratio:1;border:1px solid rgba(223,209,190,.12);border-radius:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(calc(1 + var(--p)*.42));z-index:1;pointer-events:none;opacity:0;transition:opacity 1.2s ease}
.hero-circles:before,.hero-circles:after{content:'';position:absolute;border:1px solid rgba(223,209,190,.09);border-radius:50%;inset:13%}
.hero-circles:after{inset:28%}
.hero-spotlight{position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;width:min(54vw,680px);aspect-ratio:1;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(215,178,140,.18) 0%,rgba(70,57,45,.08) 46%,transparent 72%);pointer-events:none;border-radius:50%;opacity:0;transition:opacity 1.4s ease;z-index:1}
.hero-vertical-line{position:absolute;width:1px;top:0;bottom:0;left:50%;background:linear-gradient(transparent,rgba(231,221,207,.08) 45%,transparent);pointer-events:none;z-index:1}

/* Stage Flex Layout (guarantees headline, vessel, and subtitle never collide) */
.hero-stage-content{position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:max(88px,10svh) 4% max(26px,4svh);z-index:4;pointer-events:none}

/* Top Group: Collection Identifier & Main Headline */
.hero-top-group{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;text-align:center;width:100%;max-width:1380px;margin:0 auto;pointer-events:auto;transform:translate3d(0,calc(var(--p)* -26vh),0);opacity:clamp(0,calc(1 - var(--p)*2.2),1);will-change:transform,opacity}
.hero-collection-wrap{overflow:hidden;margin-bottom:clamp(7px,1.2vh,14px);display:inline-block}
.hero-collection-label{display:block;font-family:var(--sans);font-size:clamp(9px,0.72vw,11px);font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.28em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#bda996;line-height:1.4;transform:translateY(115%);opacity:0;transition:transform .9s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),opacity .7s ease}
.hero-title-wrap{overflow:hidden;display:inline-block}
.hero-headline{display:block;font-family:var(--display);font-size:clamp(3rem,6.8vw,7.2rem);font-weight:400;letter-spacing:-.038em;line-height:.92;margin:0;text-transform:uppercase;color:#f4ecdf;text-align:center;transform:translateY(108%) rotate(1.2deg);transform-origin:left bottom;opacity:0;transition:transform 1.15s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),opacity .8s ease}

/* Center Vessel Anchor */
.hero-vessel-stage{position:relative;width:100%;flex:1 1 auto;min-height:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;pointer-events:none;padding:4px 0}
.hero-object-holder{position:relative;width:min(52vw,580px);height:clamp(300px,58svh,620px);max-height:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;z-index:3;transform:translate3d(calc(var(--mx,0)*12px),calc(var(--my,0)*-8px + var(--p)*8vh),0) scale(calc(1 + var(--p)*.48));transform-origin:center center;will-change:transform;pointer-events:none}
.hero-object-anim{width:100%;height:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;transform:translateY(32px) scale(.94);opacity:0;transition:transform 1.25s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),opacity .9s ease}
.hero-object-holder img{height:100%;width:100%;object-fit:contain;filter:drop-shadow(24px 38px 32px rgba(10,9,9,.42))}
.hero-ground{position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:4%;width:min(34vw,440px);height:30px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(15,11,8,.36);filter:blur(22px);transform:translateX(-50%) scale(calc(1 + var(--p)*.4));z-index:2;pointer-events:none;opacity:0;transition:opacity 1.2s ease}

/* Bottom Group: Italic Statement */
.hero-bottom-group{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;text-align:center;width:100%;pointer-events:auto;transform:translate3d(0,calc(var(--p)* 18vh),0);opacity:clamp(0,calc(1 - var(--p)*2.2),1);will-change:transform,opacity;margin-bottom:clamp(4px,1vh,12px)}
.hero-subtitle-wrap{overflow:hidden;display:inline-block}
.hero-subtitle{display:block;font-family:var(--display);font-style:italic;font-weight:400;font-size:clamp(1.6rem,3vw,3rem);letter-spacing:-.025em;color:#e5d7c7;margin:0;text-align:center;transform:translateY(110%) rotate(-1deg);transform-origin:center bottom;opacity:0;transition:transform 1.05s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),opacity .8s ease}

/* Corner Metadata & Interface Accents */
.hero-text-left{position:absolute;left:5.1%;bottom:5.5%;z-index:6;max-width:285px;transform:translate3d(0,calc(var(--p)*20px),0);opacity:clamp(0,calc(1 - var(--p)*2.2),1);will-change:transform,opacity}
.hero-text-left-inner{transform:translateY(16px);opacity:0;transition:opacity .85s ease,transform .85s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}
.hero-text-left p{font-size:13px;line-height:1.65;color:#c1b7aa;margin:8px 0 0}
.hero-text-right{position:absolute;right:5.1%;bottom:5.5%;z-index:6;transform:translate3d(0,calc(var(--p)*20px),0);opacity:clamp(0,calc(1 - var(--p)*2.2),1);will-change:transform,opacity}
.hero-text-right-inner{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;transform:translateY(16px);opacity:0;transition:opacity .85s ease,transform .85s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}
.hero-scroll-ring{width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid rgba(225,209,187,.55);display:grid;place-items:center;animation:ringbreathe 4s ease-in-out infinite}
.hero-scroll-ring svg{width:18px;height:18px}
.hero-side-note{position:absolute;left:4.8%;top:49%;writing-mode:vertical-rl;transform:rotate(180deg) translateY(-14px);color:#a99d8d;z-index:3;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.21em;opacity:0;transition:opacity .85s ease,transform .85s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}
.hero-index{position:absolute;right:5%;top:42%;font-family:var(--display);font-size:clamp(45px,6vw,102px);color:rgba(244,236,223,.14);font-weight:400;z-index:2;opacity:0;transform:translateY(14px);transition:opacity .85s ease,transform .85s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}
.hero-hairline{position:absolute;bottom:3.5%;left:5%;width:90%;height:1px;background:rgba(227,216,198,.18);z-index:6;opacity:0;transition:opacity .85s ease}

/* Entrance Animation Active State (.hero-entered) */
body.hero-entered .hero-collection-label{transform:translateY(0);opacity:1;transition-delay:.10s}
body.hero-entered .hero-headline{transform:translateY(0) rotate(0deg);opacity:1;transition-delay:.26s}
body.hero-entered .hero-object-anim{transform:translateY(0) scale(1);opacity:1;transition-delay:.44s}
body.hero-entered .hero-spotlight{opacity:1;transition-delay:.44s}
body.hero-entered .hero-ground{opacity:1;transition-delay:.44s}
body.hero-entered .hero-circles{opacity:1;transition-delay:.58s}
body.hero-entered .hero-subtitle{transform:translateY(0) rotate(0deg);opacity:1;transition-delay:.68s}
body.hero-entered .hero-side-note{opacity:clamp(0,calc(1 - var(--p)*2.5),1);transform:rotate(180deg) translateY(0);transition-delay:.88s}
body.hero-entered .hero-index{opacity:clamp(0,calc(1 - var(--p)*2.5),1);transform:translateY(0);transition-delay:.88s}
body.hero-entered .hero-text-left-inner{transform:translateY(0);opacity:1;transition-delay:.88s}
body.hero-entered .hero-text-right-inner{transform:translateY(0);opacity:1;transition-delay:.88s}
body.hero-entered .hero-hairline{opacity:clamp(0,calc(1 - var(--p)*2.2),1);transition-delay:.88s}
@keyframes ringbreathe{50%{transform:translateY(5px)}}
/* INBETWEEN / editorial pause */
.manifesto{background:#e8dfd1;color:#302b25;min-height:85vh;display:flex;align-items:center;padding:135px 8% 120px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}.manifesto:before{content:'S';position:absolute;right:-3%;top:-37%;font-family:var(--display);font-size:65vw;color:rgba(102,81,64,.035);line-height:1}.manifesto-content{width:min(1100px,100%);margin:auto;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 2.7fr;gap:6vw;align-items:start}.manifesto .section-id{padding-top:19px;color:#8b7764}.manifesto-statement{font-family:var(--display);font-size:clamp(49px,7.1vw,113px);letter-spacing:-.058em;line-height:.97;font-weight:400;margin:0}.manifesto-statement em{font-weight:400;color:#af8165}.manifesto-foot{max-width:350px;margin:32px 0 0 auto;font-size:15px;line-height:1.7;color:#71665b}.section-rule{height:1px;background:rgba(65,54,46,.23);margin-top:28px}
/* MACRO / IMMERSION */
.macro{height:290svh;--p:0;background:#24211e;color:#f3e9d8}.macro-stage{background:#28231e}.macro-vessel{position:absolute;left:50%;top:51%;height:73%;max-width:75%;object-fit:contain;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(calc(1 + var(--p)*2.6));opacity:clamp(0,calc(1 - var(--p)*3.3),1);z-index:1;filter:drop-shadow(15px 28px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.34))}.macro-picture{position:absolute;inset:-5%;width:110%;height:110%;object-fit:cover;clip-path:circle(calc(1% + var(--p)*114%) at 50% 55%);transform:scale(calc(1.18 - var(--p)*.16)) translateX(calc(var(--p)*-2%));filter:contrast(1.04) saturate(.77)}.macro-shade{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:2;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(20,17,14,.78),rgba(27,24,20,.13) 64%,rgba(18,17,16,.12));opacity:clamp(0,calc((var(--p) - .32)*2.6),1)}.macro-copy{position:absolute;z-index:3;left:7%;top:42%;transform:translateY(calc((1 - var(--p))*50px));opacity:clamp(0,calc((var(--p) - .36)*3.4),1)}.macro-copy h2{font-family:var(--display);font-size:clamp(73px,10vw,160px);line-height:.83;letter-spacing:-.058em;font-weight:400;margin:24px 0}.macro-copy h2 em{font-size:1.04em}.macro-side{position:absolute;z-index:3;right:6%;bottom:11%;max-width:240px;color:#e9d6c3;transform:translateY(calc((1 - var(--p))*45px));opacity:clamp(0,calc((var(--p) - .52)*4),1)}.macro-side p{font-size:14px;line-height:1.7}.macro-coord{position:absolute;z-index:3;right:5%;top:23%;writing-mode:vertical-rl;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.26em;color:#e5cbb4}
/* form index / object anatomy */
.object-study{background:#eee7dd;min-height:104vh;padding:150px 5.5% 130px;position:relative}.section-topline{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-top:17px;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#81756a}.study-layout{margin-top:58px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(250px,.8fr) minmax(500px,1.65fr);gap:5vw;align-items:center}.study-title{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:400;font-size:clamp(66px,8vw,130px);line-height:.84;letter-spacing:-.06em;margin:0}.study-title em{color:#ac846c;display:block}.study-copy{margin-top:32px;color:#74695e;max-width:315px;font-size:14px;line-height:1.8}.study-photo-wrap{background:#d9d5cd;position:relative;overflow:hidden;min-height:430px;display:flex;align-items:center}.study-photo-wrap img{width:100%;height:auto;transform:scale(1.055);transition:transform 1.6s var(--ease)}.study-photo-wrap:hover img{transform:scale(1)}.study-photo-label{position:absolute;left:22px;top:20px;color:#494641;background:rgba(240,233,223,.82);padding:8px 11px}.study-bottom{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:16px;margin-top:48px;padding-top:23px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}.study-spec{border-left:1px solid var(--line);padding-left:19px}.study-spec:first-child{border-left:0;padding-left:0}.study-spec strong{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:400;font-size:clamp(26px,3vw,46px);display:block;line-height:1.2}.study-spec span{font-size:10px;text-transform:uppercase;color:#8c7e70;letter-spacing:.12em}
/* CRAFT */
.craft{height:195svh;--p:0;background:#2e2721;color:#f5eadd}.craft-bg{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:55% 50%;transform:scale(calc(1.18 - var(--p)*.2)) translateX(calc(var(--p)*-1.6%));filter:saturate(.65) contrast(1.1)}.craft-vignette{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(22,18,16,.89) 0%,rgba(31,25,21,.54) 38%,rgba(17,14,12,.18) 70%),linear-gradient(to top,rgba(22,16,12,.7),transparent 35%)}.craft-copy{position:absolute;left:7%;top:26%;z-index:2;opacity:clamp(0,calc(var(--p)*3.6),1);transform:translateY(calc((1 - var(--p))*65px))}.craft-copy h2{font-family:var(--display);font-size:clamp(75px,11.4vw,177px);line-height:.77;letter-spacing:-.056em;font-weight:400;margin:28px 0}.craft-copy h2 em{color:#d0b49a}.craft-lede{font-size:15px;line-height:1.75;max-width:338px;color:#d8c9b8}.craft-step{position:absolute;right:6%;bottom:10%;border-top:1px solid rgba(234,217,201,.5);padding-top:17px;z-index:2;width:270px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:15px;opacity:clamp(0,calc((var(--p) - .44)*4),1)}.craft-step span{font-size:10px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.14em}.craft-step strong{font-family:var(--display);font-size:25px;font-weight:400}
/* interior reveal */
.interior{height:220svh;--p:0;background:#9d8c7c;color:#faf3ea}.interior-picture{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center center;transform:scale(calc(1.31 - var(--p)*.31));clip-path:inset(calc((1 - var(--p)) * 20%) calc((1 - var(--p))*14%) round calc((1 - var(--p))*12px));filter:brightness(calc(.77 + var(--p)*.20)) saturate(.78)}.interior-overlay{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(24,19,15,.62),rgba(27,22,18,.14) 60%,rgba(24,19,15,.10)),linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(23,19,16,.52),transparent 38%);opacity:clamp(.3,calc(.45 + var(--p)*.55),1)}.interior-copy{position:absolute;left:7%;top:28%;max-width:800px;z-index:2;opacity:clamp(0,calc((var(--p) - .18)*3.5),1);transform:translateY(calc((1 - var(--p))*50px))}.interior-copy h2{font-family:var(--display);font-size:clamp(68px,10.7vw,164px);font-weight:400;line-height:.82;letter-spacing:-.056em;margin:26px 0}.interior-copy h2 em{color:#e8ccac}.interior-side{position:absolute;right:6%;bottom:11%;max-width:245px;z-index:2;opacity:clamp(0,calc((var(--p) - .45)*3.9),1)}.interior-side .ruler{width:100%;height:1px;background:rgba(249,243,234,.55);margin-bottom:18px}.interior-side p{font-size:13px;line-height:1.7}.interior-scale{font-family:var(--display);font-size:51px;line-height:1;margin:0 0 6px}
/* collection */
.collection{height:260svh;--p:0;background:#e8e0d6;color:#292520}.collection-stage{background:var(--collection-bg,#e8e0d6);transition:background .95s;min-height:620px}.collection-stage:before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:-20%;background:radial-gradient(circle at 61% 54%,rgba(255,255,255,.48),transparent 42%);pointer-events:none}.collection-head{position:absolute;left:6%;top:19%;z-index:4;max-width:500px}.collection-head h2{font-family:var(--display);font-size:clamp(62px,8vw,124px);font-weight:400;letter-spacing:-.06em;line-height:.82;margin:18px 0 0}.collection-head h2 em{display:block}.collection-head .eyebrow{color:#847568}.collection-ghost{position:absolute;bottom:17%;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);font-family:var(--display);font-size:clamp(95px,17vw,270px);line-height:1;letter-spacing:-.09em;color:rgba(70,52,40,.06);white-space:nowrap;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .5s}.finish-art{position:absolute;left:65%;top:52%;width:min(34vw,470px);height:min(66vh,600px);transform:translate(-50%,-50%);z-index:3;pointer-events:none}.finish-object{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain;filter:drop-shadow(24px 35px 16px rgba(50,40,29,.2));opacity:0;transform:translateY(45px) rotate(4deg) scale(.93);transition:transform 1.08s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),opacity .82s ease}.finish-object.is-active{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0) rotate(0) scale(1)}.collection-info{position:absolute;left:6%;bottom:13%;z-index:4;width:min(330px,40vw)}.collection-info .num{font-family:var(--display);font-size:24px;margin-right:13px;color:#a37a5f}.collection-info .matname{font-family:var(--display);font-size:clamp(33px,3.3vw,53px);letter-spacing:-.04em}.collection-info p{font-size:14px;line-height:1.67;color:#77695c;margin:14px 0 0;max-width:300px;min-height:48px}.finish-controls{display:flex;gap:8px;position:absolute;right:6%;bottom:9%;z-index:5;align-items:center}.finish-btn{width:112px;height:53px;border:1px solid rgba(62,54,48,.25);border-radius:0;background:transparent;color:#504941;display:flex;gap:9px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;transition:background .35s,color .35s,border-color .35s}.finish-btn .swatch{width:13px;height:13px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--swatch);border:1px solid rgba(55,45,38,.15)}.finish-btn[aria-pressed="true"]{background:#292520;color:#f2ebe0;border-color:#292520}.collection-direction{position:absolute;right:6%;top:22%;display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;color:#8b7b6d}.collection-direction .track{height:1px;width:62px;background:rgba(41,38,32,.3)}.collection-index{position:absolute;right:6%;top:28%;font-family:var(--display);font-size:clamp(35px,4.5vw,75px);color:#87705f}
/* finishing editorial banner */
.edition-strip{min-height:52vh;background:#e9e1d6;display:flex;align-items:center;padding:75px 7%;border-top:1px solid rgba(42,38,32,.16)}.edition-layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1.35fr;gap:6vw;align-items:center;width:100%}.edition-layout .eyebrow{color:#907b69}.edition-layout h2{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:400;font-size:clamp(51px,6.4vw,98px);line-height:.9;letter-spacing:-.048em;margin:14px 0}.edition-layout p{max-width:500px;color:#71665b;font-size:15px;line-height:1.85}.edition-link{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:42px;padding:16px 3px;border-bottom:1px solid #777065;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.14em;font-size:11px;transition:gap .3s}.edition-link:hover{gap:56px}.edition-link svg{width:18px}
/* closing */
.closing{height:125svh;position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:#201f1d;color:#efe7dc}.closing-bg{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center 48%;filter:brightness(.7) saturate(.7);transform:scale(1.08);transition:transform 5s ease}.closing.in-view .closing-bg{transform:scale(1)}.closing-shade{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(15,15,14,.75),rgba(22,22,20,.1) 70%),linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(15,14,12,.83),transparent 43%)}.closing-inner{position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-end;padding:0 7% 14%;z-index:2}.closing-inner .eyebrow{color:#c1ad98}.closing-inner h2{font-family:var(--display);font-size:clamp(89px,14vw,214px);font-weight:400;letter-spacing:-.07em;line-height:.73;margin:29px 0 43px}.closing-inner h2 em{display:block;color:#dbbd9e}.closing-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:45px;flex-wrap:wrap}.circle-link{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:20px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.14em;font-size:11px}.circle-link .circle-arrow{width:63px;height:63px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid rgba(238,228,214,.7);display:grid;place-items:center;transition:background .35s,color .35s,transform .35s}.circle-link:hover .circle-arrow{background:#f1e9de;color:#24211e;transform:rotate(45deg)}.circle-arrow svg{height:20px;width:20px}.closing-note{font-size:14px;line-height:1.7;color:#d4c3b0;max-width:280px}
/* footer */
.footer{background:#e5dbcc;padding:65px 6% 26px;color:#312a23}.footer-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:start;gap:35px}.footer-top .eyebrow{color:#927d67}.footer-top p{font-family:var(--display);font-size:28px;max-width:325px;line-height:1.1;margin:14px 0}.footer-links{display:flex;gap:70px}.footer-links>div{display:grid;gap:13px;font-size:12px}.footer-links span{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#947e6b;margin-bottom:8px}.footer-links a{transition:color .25s}.footer-links a:hover{color:#a57458}.footer-brand{font-family:var(--display);font-size:clamp(120px,28.6vw,510px);font-weight:400;line-height:.68;letter-spacing:-.09em;text-align:center;margin:90px 0 38px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden}.footer-bottom{border-top:1px solid rgba(43,39,33,.23);padding-top:19px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;align-items:center;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#74675c}.footer-bottom button{background:none;border:0;color:inherit;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.12em;padding:2px}
/* dialog, nav overlay, utility */
.dialog-backdrop{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(20,18,16,.69);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);z-index:500;display:none;justify-content:center;align-items:center;padding:20px}.dialog-backdrop.is-open{display:flex}.dialog{width:min(540px,100%);max-height:min(90vh,760px);overflow:auto;background:#f0e8db;color:#332c26;padding:38px 40px 32px;position:relative;box-shadow:0 30px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.22)}.dialog h2{font-family:var(--display);font-size:57px;line-height:.94;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:-.05em;margin:22px 0}.dialog p{line-height:1.7;color:#796b5d;font-size:14px}.dialog .modal-close{position:absolute;right:27px;top:27px;font-size:13px;border:none;background:transparent;color:#3b352e;width:30px;height:30px}.fields{display:grid;gap:15px;margin-top:28px}.fields label{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.13em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#6e6257;display:grid;gap:8px}.fields input,.fields textarea,.fields select{width:100%;background:transparent;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid #a99c8d;padding:11px 0;outline:none;border-radius:0;color:#292620;font-size:14px;resize:vertical}.fields select{cursor:pointer}.submit-btn{margin-top:18px;width:100%;padding:16px 18px;background:#2b2824;color:#f3eadf;border:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.15em;font-size:11px}.form-result{display:none;background:#e1d5c6;padding:16px;margin-top:16px;color:#51483e;font-size:13px;line-height:1.6}.form-result.is-visible{display:block}.form-result button{margin-top:10px;border-bottom:1px solid #746b61;border-top:0;border-left:0;border-right:0;padding:6px 0;background:transparent;color:#403930;font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.11em}
.menu-surface{position:fixed;inset:0;background:#e6ddcf;color:#292520;z-index:400;visibility:hidden;clip-path:inset(0 0 100% 0);transition:clip-path .78s cubic-bezier(.78,0,.22,1),visibility .78s;display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding:110px 8% 7%}.menu-surface.is-open{visibility:visible;clip-path:inset(0 0 0 0)}.menu-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center}.menu-close{background:transparent;border:1px solid #9b8f81;padding:9px 15px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.12em;color:inherit;font-size:11px}.menu-links{margin:auto 0;display:grid;gap:4px}.menu-links a{font-family:var(--display);font-size:clamp(64px,9vw,126px);font-weight:400;line-height:1.03;letter-spacing:-.06em;transition:color .35s,transform .35s;transform-origin:left}.menu-links a:hover{color:#b38868;transform:translateX(12px)}.menu-foot{border-top:1px solid #ada091;padding-top:20px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px}
/* custom cursor */
.custom-cursor{position:fixed;left:0;top:0;width:31px;height:31px;border:1px solid rgba(193,153,114,.8);border-radius:50%;pointer-events:none;z-index:550;transform:translate3d(-100px,-100px,0) translate(-50%,-50%);transition:width .25s,height .25s,background .25s,border-color .25s;mix-blend-mode:difference}.custom-cursor.on-link{width:55px;height:55px;background:rgba(236,211,180,.19);border-color:#e3cbb4}

 <div class="manifesto-content"><div class="section-id eyebrow reveal">02 / The philosophy</div><div><h2 class="manifesto-statement reveal">Some objects fill a room. <em>Others give it room to breathe.</em></h2><div class="section-rule reveal d1"></div><p class="manifesto-foot reveal d2">STRATA explores the space between art and everyday life—where material, memory, and the mark of the hand meet.</p></div></div>
